plugins.description: American Fox® Trading Platform provides performance statistics, strategy versions, and historical results across multiple markets. Its AI-managed, self-evolving algorithms study market behavior and price dynamics. Algorithm changes may not improve performance. The plugin supports research and monitoring; it does not execute trades or provide personalized investment advice. Historical results offer context, without guaranteeing future performance, predictive accuracy, or a trading advantage.
